utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hi Cleo! Did you hear? The repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I didn't know! I've been gathering supplies for Saturday. Thanks for the heads up, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem, Cleo! Let me know if you need any help moving the supplies over to Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm still a bit confused about the repair drive—Dane said Sunday, but I thought I heard Saturday. Do you know for sure when it is?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sorry, Opal, I'm not entirely sure. I've heard different things too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Maybe we should check with Mara or Dane to get the straight story. I want to make sure I show up on the right day.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey, do you know how much the community lawnmower costs? I'm trying to see if we need a separate fund for it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I'm not sure about the lawnmower cost—haven't heard anything. Still trying to pin down the repair drive details, any word on that?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I'm not asking about the repair drive, Nell. I need to know the cost of the community lawnmower for a separate fund.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's this Saturday at the community center. Need some help?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right! Sorry, I spaced out. Yes, I could use a hand. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, see you there Saturday morning. I'll bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Tess, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, actually it's been moved to Sunday at the community center! I'm bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to know! I'll bring my broken lamp then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus, what's this about a repair drive? Just the gist, I'm in a rush.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Noah's organizing it—people bring broken stuff and we fix it together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it. When and where exactly?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A repair drive? Yes, I think I have an old toaster that needs fixing. Or was it a lamp? I can't quite remember...

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A toaster? That sounds like something that could be fixed. Where exactly is this drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I'm not sure where it's happening... Maybe at the community center? Or was it in someone's garage? My memory's a bit hazy.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Faye, are we still on for the potluck idea? I think it could really bring in more families.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I think the potluck is a great idea! And just a heads up, I heard the drive was moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Sunday at the community center sounds good! Should I spread the word about the change?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hey Rosa, do you know if there's a sign-up list for the repair drive? I don't want to haul my blender over there for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Pia! No sign-up needed, just bring it to the community center this Sunday instead of Saturday. I'll be there to help!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's a relief! So just show up Sunday at the community center with my blender—no sign-up needed? I'll do that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, are you planning to check out the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm definitely planning to be there! And I already told the organizer I'd help set things up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's awesome, Sam! I'm glad you're helping out—I'll see you there bright and early.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, I'll wait for Sam to confirm. I like having things planned out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Are you sure you heard that right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh yes, I've heard it from a few folks. Ira mentioned they're fixing electronics too, and Gus offered his tools. Sam said it's aimed for next weekend.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Hana! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We're fixing things together—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I've heard about it! Do you know what items people are bringing? I'm trying to get a clear list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I think it's mostly basic tools and spare parts—hammers, screwdrivers, paint, that sort of thing. You can bring whatever you have handy!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Sam, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I heard about it! I'd love to help out. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That's great! Are you planning to bring something to fix, or would you like to volunteer your time?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I'll be there. Do you know if they'll have parts for lawnmowers?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm not sure about lawnmower parts specifically, but Dane might know—he's been coordinating the supplies. The drive is at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, I'll check with Dane. But actually, do you know about the community fund for buying a new lawnmower?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I'm not sure I can make it this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive—sorry, weekends can be tricky. No worries, let me know if something else works.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I've got some personal stuff to handle, but I appreciate you asking.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, this Saturday! Bring that toaster along, we'll have it fixed in no time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Saturday! Right, I'll try to remember the toaster... or was it something else?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No problem, Oren! I can remind you on Friday if you'd like.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We're fixing things together — want to join?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely! I've been telling everyone about it. Can't wait to see the whole neighborhood come together this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I'm so glad you're on board! See you Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Dane, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center, and we're thinking of adding a potluck to get more folks involved!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: A potluck sounds great! Count me in for bringing something.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Awesome, Dane! I'll let the group know you're on board.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo. I'd appreciate that. I'd hate to lug my blender there only to find it's not the right day.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll double-check the flyer when I get home and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo. I'll wait to hear from you before I plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, I've heard both Saturday and Sunday for the repair drive. Which one is it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure either, I've heard both days mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got Mara saying Saturday and Dane saying Sunday. It's driving me nuts trying to pin down the right day.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there's a repair drive happening? Could you fill me in on the details?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, there's a repair drive this Saturday at the community center! We're fixing up old electronics together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, Saturday at the community center—thanks! What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli! Just a heads-up, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, thanks for letting me know, Rosa. I appreciate the heads-up, though I wish it was on Saturday as planned.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I know, sorry for the last-minute change. Can you still make it on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh hey Kira! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. We're fixing up old electronics and stuff. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive? Are you sure you heard that right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I'm sure! I heard it from Quinn and Vik — it's definitely this Saturday at the community center. We're fixing up old electronics and stuff.
